w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🌙 Night. The lingering Highbeam Deer gorges at the treeline — 600 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering White Noise gorges at the treeline — 1,400 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Juan won't meet your eye. You said you'd help with the food I needed — and it never happened. Promises rot. (-15 trust)
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.
